notes: KINGDOM WARS 1.0.0 build 61. Combat: the melee contract now holds for all seven families. The overhead attack has a real recovery and genuinely clears the head; Fury is driven from the ground instead of playing on a frozen pelvis; the shield thrust drives the SHIELD (it was driving the sword) and returns to guard; both basic sword attacks now unwind their wind-up instead of finishing cocked back. Blade direction comes from the forearm plus a bounded wrist, so the sword can no longer orbit free of the hand. Garrison: GARRISON_BAND has always been documented as 'safe' but only the heal honoured it -- bleed, arrows and melee all reached units behind the wall. Ordinary damage can no longer undo a garrison heal; siege still can, so falling back is cover and never immunity. Performance: body separation compared every unit against every other unit (47,089 iterations per step at 217 units) and spear denial walked the whole defender list per unit. Both now use the sorted index that already existed. Gameplay is bit-identical. UI: new cinematic Landing built only from KWARS production visuals, and a Home with one dominant real-save CONTINUE. Screen shake stays OFF by default. Save schema 3 unchanged; PWA identity and the auth key deliberately keep their legacy spelling.
